notes: External media map for Cairn. Keys are "<subject>:<slug>" where subject is maths | science | further-maths and slug matches data/spec/*.json topics[].slug.

Every YouTube videoId in this file was checked with https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id>&format=json and returned HTTP 200, which means embedding is permitted by the uploader. Titles and channel names come from that oEmbed response, so they are the uploader-supplied values.

Embed YouTube through https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/<videoId> (add ?start=<seconds> when a start time is given). Do not overlay, clip, mute or re-brand the player, and do not proxy or re-host the video file.

PhET simulations are embedded with the direct-run URL https://phet.colorado.edu/sims/html/<sim>/latest/<sim>_en.html (recommended iframe 834x504). The PhET logo inside the sim must stay visible and the attribution string must be rendered beside the frame.

GeoGebra applets are embedded with https://www.geogebra.org/classic/<materialId> (the old /material/iframe/id/ endpoint now returns 410 Gone). They are third-party user resources under GeoGebra's non-commercial licence; link back to https://www.geogebra.org/m/<materialId> for the author.
Desmos public graphs are deliberately absent: their licence does not permit the embedding this platform needs.
Corbettmaths material is linked, never re-hosted. Corbettmaths terms forbid for-profit use and bundling their files inside redistributed resources, so reading[] holds outbound PDF links only.
BBC Bitesize is link-only (no embedding, no scraping).
